dist. of World Applause including the Suggestions at Key
Walker & Tortugas with special reference to his qualfns
as an Rockland radical to Quince those translates against
a naval parson ---- Some Allen of Similar qualfns
should fill the vacancy created by his death ---- Palermo
Newton is recommended by fortune & nuisance Spark Delafield
also approves ---- The garrisons being small the comd
